Where these come from. Price and market cap: CoinGecko. TVL: DefiLlama. Transaction cost and time: Stellar Horizon fee stats and ledger close times — exact. Total assets: counted on stellar.expert. Lifetime transactions counts XLM payments plus DEX trades — the one figure that is not a whole-network total, because no free source publishes one. DEX volume, trades and most-traded are summed over the major XLM pairs (—) — a sample of the DEX, so read them as a floor.
